items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And he came and stayed with us many a time.

ctx.x: And then, as we moved, wherever we would come, he knew and we’d tell him, look Jo, whenever you feel out of sorts, where we are, you’ve got a home.
And he came and stayed with us many a time.

And sometime he’d stay one week or two weeks, or sometimes a day, bing and he’s gone, or he’s going to see some other musicians like up in San Diego then go to L.A., that type of thing, make his rounds.
